quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. The Revesby order has been two cartons light every week since a wet Monday and the invoice says otherwise every time. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do that and we're square.

the pallet as it actually arrives

quests.title: The Credit Note, Revesby
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $65 owing to Revesby and it is not going to walk in here itself. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: $65, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Revesby Run
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. I do the Revesby run at two in the afternoon and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Panania
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. I have got a folding table in the back of the van and the Revesby shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

get one in you, this takes a while

quests.title: The Regulars, Revesby
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Three of the Revesby regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $10 down on those days. This is the third time I have had this conversation. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$10, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Revesby
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Everything Revesby sells comes off a floor at Panania, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. It started small, the way these things do. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us
